notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty is in the IntoGames 2025 bundle!
notes.notes:
I'm so happy to announces ITTY BITTY TOILET KITTY is part of the Into Games Bundle 2025! 

Into Games is a fantastic charity and every penny from buying the bundle will go towards their vital work. There are some absolute cracking games in there, and I have to confess I'm a little humbled that my game is among them. 

 18 titles for £12. Bargain!

https://www.fanatical.com/en/bundle/into-games-bundle-2025

notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty @ Manchester Meetup powered by Twitch
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to Middle Aged Gamer Guy for inviting me to showcase Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty at Manchester Meet Up powered by Twitch. Not only did I get to showcase the whole game in front of the lovely attendees, but it also got shown on the front page of Twitch as part of the event! 

If you're interested streaming, or just want to talk games with cool people, then this is a fantastic event to go to which I would highly recommend.

notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty @GDLX!
notes.notes:
Had a blast showcasing Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty at GDLX! 

Was my first time going and I definitely feel it’s an essential event that should be on everyone’s calendar. 

Some super fab games being showcased and I only wish I had a bit more time so I could’ve played them all.

notes.title: Introductory offer ends tomorrow. Final chance to get 20% off!
notes.notes:
It's the final day to get Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty's introductory offer! If you want to get 20% off the game, now is the time to buy.

Also if you do buy it please don't forget to leave a review. It's so important in getting the Steam algorithm on our side and getting more people to play the game!

notes.title: Lovely review of Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty from GEEKGASM!
notes.notes:
Huge thank you to Geekgasm for this lovely review of Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty!

notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty on Twitch!
notes.notes: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty has only been out for a few days but already it's getting some fantastic streams by streamers.  A big shout out to AtomicMoonchild, BryonDredd, Binglejay, CatGirlFingies and many over who have streamed the game.  it's been tremendous fun watching their reactions  and enjoying their laughter!

notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty it OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty it OUT NOW! 

My little kitten has finally grown up into a big beautiful cat and is ready to  take on the world. And to celebrate it's release, Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty will have 20% off.

Sharpen your claws and get ready to catch those Greebles!

notes.title: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty is going to GDLX
notes.notes: Itty Bitty Toilet Kitty will be showcasing at GDLX this month. Super excited to be in such a great liner up  and to continue getting this little game into the big wide world. If you're going along to GDLX, do pop by and say hello!
